name: recall_memories
description: Search remembered knowledge and past events. Fetch full text with recall_memories id=<id>. Use include_forgotten to include forgotten memories when needed.

query.description: Search keywords or a question. May be omitted only when fetching directly by id.

id.description: Fetch the full text of a single memory directly by id.

scope.description: all searches knowledge points and events (default); episode searches only past events.

max_results.description: Optional limit on the number of results.
